senses.en_definition: An invitation or request to look at, check, or pay attention to something, softened or emphasized according to context.

collocations.en: Have a look at this photo.

senses.en_definition: An invitation or request to visit someone, especially a sick person or a relative.

collocations.en: Go and visit your mother back in the village.
Go and visit them in hospital.

senses.en_definition: A noncommittal response indicating that a decision will depend on how things turn out.

messages.en: Have a look at the photos I sent earlier. The one by the beach is nice, isn't it?
It is! But my face looks a bit dark. Got any other photos?
Yeah, hang on, I'll send the others. Just pick whichever one you like.
About that plan for the weekend, have you asked the others yet?
Not yet, I'm a bit busy right now. Let's talk it over tonight, then I'll ask them.

collocations.en: talk about him, her, or it
information about him, her, or it

messages.en: What about that new course? Have you read up on it yet?
Yeah, but only a little. I'll send you the link later.

senses.en_definition: An organized armed force trained for warfare and defence.
A member of the armed forces; a soldier.

collocations.en: a member of the armed forces

senses.en_definition: Military; relating to or intended for the armed forces, used as a modifier in compound nouns.

messages.en: Has your older brother joined the armed forces? I saw a photo of him in uniform.
Yeah, he starts training next week. He's getting his stuff ready now.
Oh, so there's still time to see him this weekend. Ask him to come out for a drink with us.
